intro: Ambermill Investigations is a Forsaken mission assigned by Shadow Priest Allister from the Sepulcher. With Dalaran wizards weaving magic in the nearby town of Ambermill, the Forsaken must disrupt their spellwork and strip their magical foci to keep hold of Silverpine Forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Dalar is attempting to locate the source of the wizards' spellcasting. For now, we'll have to slow their progress in any way we can...
The conjurers, mages and protectors are no doubt carrying the pendants. Remove and retrieve them.
Take the main road south and the eastern fork into Ambermill.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We must hurry, their plans must not come to fruition, or we may lose our hold on Silverpine Forest.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Dalar has found that the weaving is quite far along, despite the setback.
A wizard of great power is guiding the magic energy. He must be stopped quickly.
